coverage.expression_transform: log2(batch-normalized RSEM + 1); not a dependency score
limits: This curated PanCancer Atlas cohort is distinct from the initial 633-case GDC catalog query.
Tumor expression is observational context, not evidence that WRN knockout or a drug benefits people.
MSI scores are retained continuously; no patient MSI categories are inferred.
Source MSIsensor description overlaps MSS and indeterminate ranges; it is not used to classify tumors.
Missing measurements remain missing, never zero or MSS.
No individual-level join exists between TCGA tumors and DepMap cell lines.

source.citation: TCGA PanCancer Atlas (Cell, 2018), accessed through cBioPortal. See study metadata for individual publications.
source.adaptations: Select six fields; retain all 594 samples; compute log2(RSEM + 1); summarize measurement coverage.
